raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

This affects prefill serving of GLM-5.3-Flash, which uses the pooled DSA `IndexerKPool`.

`IndexerKPool._kpool_topk_by_row_chunks` calls `fp8_mqa_logits` with `clean_logits=True`, which initializes the full `[query rows x concatenated pooled KV rows]` FP32 logits buffer to `-inf` before the scorer writes each row's valid range. The buffer can be several GiB at long context.

The downstream KPool top-k already receives `row_starts` and `pool_lens` and reads only `score[row, row_start : row_start + pool_len]`. Initializing positions outside those ranges is therefore redundant. This is the KPool equivalent of the non-pooled indexer optimization merged in #28757.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa/dsa_indexer_kpool.py`: pass `clean_logits=False` to the ragged KPool MQA-logits call. Valid logits are unchanged; positions outside each row's declared range remain uninitialized and are not read by KPool top-k.
- Extend the gfx950 real-kernel test to compare `clean_logits=True` and `False` through the production KPool top-k transform at GLM-5.3-Flash geometry (`32 x 128`, KPool 4, token top-k 2048).
- Make KPool chunking unit tests require `clean_logits=False` on both ROCm/AITER and CUDA/DeepGEMM paths.

## Accuracy Tests

GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`, MI355X/gfx950, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261013`, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, thinking enabled, seed 0, and separate fresh caches.

TP4 used context 65,536, 1,319 GSM8K questions, 64 threads, and max output 32,768. TP8 used context 131,072, 1,319 questions, 1,200 threads, and max output 4,096.

| configuration | GSM8K | truncated | errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TP4 baseline (`clean_logits=True`, `d8dd49d21d`) | 97.27% | 0% | 0% |
| TP4 candidate (`clean_logits=False`, `440cf03231`) | 96.66% | 0% | 0% |
| TP8 baseline (`clean_logits=True`, `d8dd49d21d`) | 96.89% | 0.08% | 0% |
| TP8 candidate (`clean_logits=False`, `440cf03231`) | 96.59% | 0.53% | 0% |

These are single stochastic scoring passes. All four runs completed 1,319 questions without errors.

Focused correctness:

| path | result |
|---|---|
| AITER FP8 MQA logits → ordinary masked top-k | identical selected sets |
| AITER FP8 MQA logits → KPool fused top-k transform | identical selected sets |

- `test_dsa_skip_logits_clean.py`: 2 passed.
- `test_kpool_stream_scheduling.py`: 13 passed.

No model arithmetic inside the valid logits ranges changes.

## Speed Benchmarks

MI355X/gfx950, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261013`, SGLang `84bd7ab1884cee885fafce9c94f5c9ad80a4f0b8`, AITER `e7d2453f25e5aaeea72a3a40b284ba453e026624`, PyTorch `2.11.0+rocm7.2`, Triton `3.7.0`. FP8 MQA scorer GPU-event medians after warmup, seven measurements per cell, `H=32`, `D=128`.

| query rows | concatenated KV rows | clean=True (ms) | clean=False (ms) | delta |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 128 | 4,096 | 0.048 | 0.042 | -11.3% |
| 1,024 | 16,384 | 0.129 | 0.119 | -7.2% |
| 4,096 | 65,536 | 1.547 | 1.203 | -22.2% |
| 8,192 | 131,072 | 7.120 | 6.353 | -10.8% |

A separate concurrency-64-shaped segmented case used 64 requests, 128 query rows and 2,048 pooled KV rows per request (`8,192 x 131,072` output, 4 GiB). Skipping initialization reduced scorer time from 2.605 ms to 1.960 ms (**-24.8%**) and produced identical KPool top-k selections.

These are component timings only; no end-to-end performance improvement is claimed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing documentation change is needed.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
